_comment: Model matrix for the eval suite. Endpoint facts (base URL, key env var, rate limit, context window) come from the brain's provider registry in brain/olite/substrate/llm/providers.py, so the evals resolve an endpoint exactly the way the app does. A model whose envRequires are unset is skipped, not failed, so a local run works without every credential (loom's rule). To use an endpoint the registry does not know, give baseUrl instead of provider.
